responsibility: This header computes compile-time dependency closures for AArch64 architectural features, extensions, and CPUs. By re-including the architecture, extension, and core definition tables into constexpr templates and helpers, it derives per-feature enabled sets, explicit-on and explicit-off relationships, reverse dependency masks, and per-CPU feature closures that are then used by option parsing, native CPU detection, and ISA string construction code to reason consistently about transitive feature implications.
